description: Repeatability: same neutral-driver configuration run twice with identical Philox key/counter must give identical particle states.

candidate_philox.derivation: identical Philox key and counter reused for both repeats to prove bit-identical reruns

notes: No oracle counterpart is executed: the Fortran oracle exposes no seed control, so repeated oracle runs are not a controlled experiment and no multi-seed oracle parity is claimed.
Migrated from v1 without scientific change: based_on PBL-NEUTRAL-005; domain, release, wind and integration are identical to the neutral configuration and the surface block is the neutral surface.
Requirement: bit-identical particle states across repeats.
Oracle overrides document the shared neutral configuration only; no oracle run is performed for this case.

The Fortran oracle exposes no seed control: random_mod.f90 alloc_random hard-codes iseed1=-7-i and iseed2=-88-i per OpenMP thread, with no COMMAND namelist override. Repeated oracle runs are therefore not a controlled multi-seed experiment; no multi-seed oracle parity is claimed.
